AND r.check_in <= c.day AND (r.check_out IS NULL OR r.check_out > c.day) GROUP BY c.day, ar.room_id` with `COUNT(r.reservation_id) AS active_count` (the iter577 LEFT-JOIN-COUNT-non-null-right-col form, NOT COUNT(*)).
